subject: Accessing an argument inside the map expression

messages.author: 5632195ef1c0e279
messages.subject: Accessing an argument inside the map expression
parts:
Hi,

While I execute an R script (containing a map reduce job) from unix
command line, I pass an argument to it which I access inside the
script through:

n <- commandArgs()

Now one of the arguments I pass is required inside the map expression
to evaluate a condition using IF. But as such I know we cannot access
it inside the map expression. So i wrote a map.setup expression and
used it in rhmr.

n <- commandArgs() # n is a vector
map.setup <- expression({
d <- n[8]
print(d) # to check if map.setup is executed; I dont get the output
for this line.
)}

map <- expression({
#Use 'd' inside this in an if statement
)}

rhmr(...,setup = list(map=map.setup))

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: Accessing an argument inside the map expression
parts:
n is not available. Use your commandArgs and pass it in mapred like this


mapred=list(n=rawToChar(serialize(n, NULL,ascii=TRUE)))

in the setup, do this

n <-  unserialize(charToRaw(Sys.getenv("n")))
